svg.title: A year at the workbench — public GitHub activity
svg.desc: 863 contributions across 137 active days, from 2 Nov 2025 through 4 Nov 2026. Longest streak 11 days. Busiest day 22 Feb 2026 with 40. Weekly totals are drawn above the calendar. Snapshot 2026-11-04.
svg.text: Public GitHub contributions, one square per day.
